data.name: Planet Surf: The Last Wave
data.detailed_description:
Planet Surf: The Last Wave is a physics/arcade/surf game on space! The ultimate surf trip!

Ride the planet's last wave while dodging deadly meteors! You have 3 minutes to collect enough energy crystals before the planet explodes.

  • Ride endless waves!
  • Dodge deadly meteors!
  • Surf in unique planets!
  • Beat your friend's score with planet specific leaderboards!
  • Original soundtrack!
  • Become the best surfer in the galaxy!

data.short_description: It's space surf season, year 2183. And as usual, the planet is about to explode! You have only 3 minutes to surf its last wave, get enough energy crystals for your hyper-foil board to get you out in one piece. Will you be able to make it to the next planet?
